description.value: Galaxy Gardens Restaurant is a long-standing casual dining spot in Prince Rupert serving both authentic Cantonese cuisine and western-style Chinese food, making it one of the better Chinese dining options northwest of Vancouver. The restaurant seats families and large parties, and also offers takeout, delivery, and full catering for events. For touring cyclists passing through Prince Rupert on the North Coast, it provides a substantial sit-down or takeout meal option in a community with limited dining variety.

address.value: 844 3rd Ave W, Prince Rupert, BC V8J 1M6
